EGG-ONOMICS / DATA THROUGH DECEMBER 2014

Six-month validation and test in 2014.

Validation selects Naive. Lowest observed test RMSE belongs to Seasonal ARIMA search. Validation: Jan 2014 to Jun 2014; test: Jul 2014 to Dec 2014. Each forecast is issued once from its origin and is not updated within the six-month window.

The original BLS/FRED snapshot contains 544 monthly observations from January 1980 to April 2025. The active analysis uses only the 420 observations through December 2014: 408 training months through December 2013, six validation months in January-June 2014, and six test months in July-December 2014. Later prices appear only in the full-history graph. No prices are filled or interpolated.

This single history graph keeps all observations visible. The blue line marks January 2014, when validation begins; the green line marks July 2014, when testing begins. The red line marks January 2015: prices in the grey area remain visible for context but are excluded from the analysis.

Training STL seasonal strength: 0.397. All ACF lags are months.

The 2014 validation and test months were chosen retrospectively. This changes both the evaluation dates and the horizon from the older 2024-2025 experiment, so the scores should not be presented as a like-for-like accuracy improvement. This cutoff also does not remove earlier fluctuations or shocks from training history.

Automatic ETS and ARIMA structures are selected using each fitting window only. ARIMA searches use AICc, exact maximum likelihood and stepwise search. The six-month forecast horizon does not change the monthly seasonal period of 12.

6 / Earlier exploratory work

The earlier pre-spike experiment and the original three-month results remain separate from this revised 2014 study. Those experiments use different dates and are not part of the current validation or test scores.

Reproduce with analysis/forecast.R. Predictions, means, intervals, parameters, data-quality checks and fitted objects are saved in results.
